title: Albanian revolts of 1833–1839
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Albanian revolts of 1833–1839", at revision 1375833163, opens: "The Albanian revolts of 1833–1839 took place in Albania as a reaction against the new centralizing policy of Ottoman administration." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q4709162, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "rebellions in Albania against the Ottoman Empire". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
